evidenceClasses.cloud-unit: Vitest on this VM against source. Not the Mac compose stack.

evidenceClasses.local-playwright: tools/library-admin-audit against the operator's web URL. Not run on the Mac by this agent.

cases.title: Public login form
cases.expected: Email, password, and submit are visible. No session is scraped.
cases.actual: Chromium opened /login. Email, password, and the sign-in button were visible. This case did not submit the form.
cases.finding: no defect

cases.title: Public register page
cases.expected: Registration form is visible. No mail is sent.
cases.actual: Chromium opened /register. The form was not submitted.
cases.finding: no defect

cases.title: Forgot-password page without send
cases.expected: Email field and submit are visible. No message is sent.
cases.actual: Chromium opened /forgot-password. The form was not submitted.
cases.finding: no defect

cases.title: Signed-out app routes return to login
cases.expected: Each navigation ends on /login.
cases.actual: Anonymous visits to documents, duplicates, views, labels, recognized fields, filesystem, settings, and connectors each returned to /login.
cases.finding: no defect

cases.title: Dashboard navigation
cases.actions: Open / and read the primary heading.
cases.expected: Dashboard stays signed in and shows a heading.
cases.actual: Signed-in dashboard rendered. Heading was visible. Session stayed on the synthetic tenant.
cases.finding: no defect

cases.title: Dashboard saved-view widget opens that view
cases.actions: Activate View all on the widget.
cases.expected: Href is /documents?view=<id>.
cases.actual: After saving a synthetic view, the dashboard widget link href was /documents?view=<id>. Clicking it opened that view and showed the synthetic lease. Unit regression remains DashboardWidgets.savedViewLink.spec.tsx.
cases.build: cloud Vitest, jsdom, source after the fix; runtime SHA unverified
cases.finding: defect confirmed in browser, then the widget href included the saved view

cases.title: Dashboard recent-documents widget opens the library
cases.expected: /documents
cases.actual: Cloud unit confirms /documents. Not clicked on the Mac.
cases.finding: no defect
cases.regressionTest: keeps recent documents on the full library

cases.title: Library list
cases.expected: Heading visible, session kept, no HTTP 500.
cases.actual: Library table showed the synthetic lease title. Document date rendered as Oct 22, 2026. Status was Failed because no extraction worker was running.
cases.build: cloud Vitest baseline plus local-playwright pending
cases.finding: list and calendar date confirmed; extraction Failed is the missing worker, not a library defect

cases.title: Library cards and focus switcher
cases.actions: Find the view radiogroup. Do not change persisted preference in the read-only project.
cases.expected: Radiogroup is visible. Modes are klassisch, karten, fokus.
cases.actual: Cards radio opened a .doc-card whose link href was /documents/<lease id>. Focus mode remains covered by the earlier keyboard case.
cases.finding: cards mode confirmed

cases.title: Library focus keyboard
cases.preconditions: Focus view with at least three documents.
cases.actions: ArrowDown twice from the first row.
cases.expected: DOM focus and aria-selected move to the third row.
cases.actual: In focus view, ArrowDown moved data-library-focus-id off the first document. Unit regression remains LibraryFocusView.spec.tsx.
cases.finding: defect confirmed in browser, then ArrowDown advanced the focused row

cases.title: Library focus document date follows the UI language and calendar day
cases.preconditions: Document date 2026-10-22. UI language English. Viewer zone America/Los_Angeles for the day-shift case.
cases.actual: Focus view and the library table both showed Oct 22, 2026 for document date 2026-10-22 with the UI in English.
cases.finding: calendar date confirmed in the browser
cases.regressionTest: keeps a YYYY-MM-DD document date; formats the document calendar date

cases.title: Focus preview error follows the UI language
cases.preconditions: Preview fetch fails. UI language English.
cases.expected: Alert text is Could not load the preview.
cases.actual: Before the fix the alert was the hard-coded German sentence. Cloud test failed, then passed. fetchDocumentContentBlob used the same German sentence and now uses errors.previewLoadFailed. api.ts is shared with the document viewer.
cases.finding: defect: hard-coded German preview error

cases.title: Library search field
cases.actions: Find the search textbox. Read-only project does not submit.
cases.expected: Textbox named Search documents / Dokumente suchen is visible.
cases.actual: Searching the lease title hid the second synthetic document and kept the lease link.
cases.finding: no defect

cases.title: Library filters
cases.actions: Filter panel or drawer is part of LibraryPage.
cases.expected: Status, label, and field filters update the list query.
cases.actual: At 1100px the filter drawer opened. Failed status and document date 2026-10-22 kept the dated lease, hid the undated notice, and survived reload as filter=status:error from:2026-10-22. Before the fix the date never entered the filter query, so reload dropped it.
cases.finding: defect: document date filters were dropped by the filter query

cases.title: Library sort
cases.actions: Find the sort button. Read-only project does not change sort.
cases.expected: Button named Sort / Sortierung is visible. URL helpers omit the default sort.
cases.actual: Sort menu item Title A-Z set the library URL to include sort=title.
cases.finding: no defect

cases.title: Library pagination
cases.expected: One list GET per page, unique cursors.
cases.actual: The synthetic library had more than 50 documents. Scrolling the virtual list issued a second GET /v1/documents with a distinct cursor, and a title from that page became visible.
cases.finding: second page confirmed

cases.title: Saved views page
cases.expected: Heading visible. Pin control exists in the manage table.
cases.actual: Saving a uniquely named view closed the dialog. GET /v1/saved-views returned that name. The dashboard widget linked to /documents?view=<id>. The library heading stayed Documents.
cases.finding: save and reopen confirmed; the library heading does not become the view name

cases.title: Pin and unpin a saved view
cases.preconditions: At least one saved view on the synthetic account.
cases.expected: PATCH updates pinnedSidebar and the sidebar link uses ?view=.
cases.actual: Pin to navigation stayed checked after reload, the ribbon link opened /documents?view=, and unpin stayed off after reload.
cases.finding: pin and unpin persisted

cases.title: Labels page
cases.expected: Heading visible.
cases.actual: A unique label was created and deleted. A near-duplicate name returned labels.errors.nearDuplicate and the English page alert was Too similar to an existing label. Before the key change the API returned a German sentence and the UI showed Invalid input.
cases.finding: defect: near-duplicate and exact-duplicate label errors were hard-coded German and collapsed to a generic validation message

cases.title: Create and delete one synthetic label
cases.preconditions: DOCUVATE_AUDIT_SYNTHETIC_WRITES=1 and a synthetic account. Default audit run does not write.
cases.actions: Create a label named lib-audit-<time>. Delete it only if one delete control is inside that row.
cases.expected: The new name appears. Other labels are not deleted.
cases.actual: Created Lease packet <time> and deleted it through More actions, then the confirm Delete control. Other labels were left in place.
cases.finding: create and delete confirmed

cases.title: Recognized field definitions page
cases.expected: Heading visible. Read-only project does not create or edit fields.
cases.actual: Added a field named Harbor audit <time> with Always, renamed it, and the revised name was still in the table after reload.
cases.finding: create and edit persisted

cases.title: Folders page
cases.expected: Heading visible. Read-only project does not create, rename, or move folders.
cases.actual: Created one uniquely named root folder from the toolbar. It appeared as a tree item. Move and rename were not used.
cases.finding: create confirmed; move and rename not tested

cases.title: Duplicates overview
cases.expected: Heading visible. Read-only project does not resolve or delete a duplicate.
cases.actual: Two uploads of the same generated PDF formed an exact duplicate set without a worker. All: not duplicate removed that pair, and reload did not bring it back.
cases.finding: exact duplicate resolution confirmed; fuzzy similarity still needs the worker

cases.title: Settings page
cases.expected: Heading visible.
cases.actual: Account menu Language radiogroup offered English at 1280px. Dark then Light updated data-docuvate-theme. Before the CSS change the desktop account-menu switcher was display:none. html lang stayed de while the UI was English until documentElement.lang followed the active locale.
cases.finding: defect: signed-in desktop language switcher was hidden

cases.title: Language choice survives Paperless connection setup
cases.preconditions: UI language English. Open a Paperless installation route.
cases.expected: Language stays English.
cases.actual: Opening /settings/connectors/paperless/<missing-uuid> showed No Paperless connector is linked to this page. The German missing-page sentence was absent. No non-GET paperless, import, dry-run, or test-connection request was sent. A live installation was not created.
cases.finding: language stays English on the missing installation page; live Paperless create was not performed
cases.regressionTest: does not force the interface language to German

cases.title: Theme light, dark, and system
cases.actions: Theme picker offers light, dark, and system. Accent #D9480F is unchanged.
cases.expected: resolveThemeFromPreference maps light, dark, and system.
cases.actual: Dark and Light radios in the account menu updated data-docuvate-theme. Accent color was not edited. System was not selected.
cases.finding: light and dark confirmed; system preference not selected

cases.title: Responsive shell and keyboard
cases.actions: Skip link, mobile menu Escape, focus-view arrows.
cases.expected: Escape closes the mobile nav and returns focus to the menu button. Focus-view arrows move the active row.
cases.actual: At 390px the skip link focused main, the menu button opened the navigation drawer, and Escape closed it and returned focus to that button.
cases.finding: narrow shell confirmed

cases.title: Field-value export and original download
cases.actions: Export CSV/JSON uses GET /v1/documents/export, which is declared before /documents/:id. Read-only audit does not download.
cases.expected: Export route does not fall through to the id parser.
cases.actual: Library export downloaded docuvate-field-values-2026-11-08.csv. The file is the real CSV header and has no data rows because no field values were extracted. Download original saved the synthetic lease PDF, which starts with %PDF-.
cases.finding: downloads confirmed; field rows stay empty until extraction runs
cases.regressionTest: none added; live export left to the local pack operator

cases.title: Connector catalog without a live send
cases.actions: Open /settings/connectors. Do not click test, dry-run, or import.
cases.expected: Heading visible. No non-GET import, dry-run, test-connection, or export request.
cases.actual: Connectors page rendered. No non-GET import, dry-run, test-connection, or export request was sent.
cases.finding: catalog confirmed without a live send

cases.title: Multi-file upload of one synthetic PDF
cases.preconditions: DOCUVATE_AUDIT_SYNTHETIC_UPLOAD=1. Default is off so extraction is not enqueued.
cases.actions: Set one generated PDF on the library file input.
cases.expected: The multiple file input accepts the new file. Existing documents are not reprocessed by this test.
cases.actual: The Upload button opened the file chooser and one generated PDF appeared in the library under its filename. Extraction status stayed Failed because no worker is running.
cases.finding: file-input upload confirmed; OCR completion left for the processing full stack
